content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"CO-97 is a bundling denial, not an authorization, information, or medical-necessity issue, so retro authorization, records submission, peer-to-peer review, and a necessity appeal would not properly address it. Resubmission risks CO-18, and the balance cannot be billed to the patient unless it is established as contractual patient responsibility. A specialist must review the related paid service and payer bundling edit before deciding whether a coding appeal or contractual write-off is appropriate."}
